about: Search reports in this directory that record a past measurement and are not held to the current engine. engine/tools/verify_search_suite.py checks each file against its sha256 and skips the replay, printing the reason; --include-historical replays them anyway. A report that should stay reproducible is NOT listed here, and the tool then replays it. See README.md, 'Which reports still replay'.

pilot-v1-results.json.reason: 2026-09-17 measurement on the engine of that day; frozen as a record, never regenerated. The engine and the fixture tree have both moved since, so it no longer replays. Its manifest names three fixtures the 2026-09-25 A9/A10 re-seed (#2915) removed.
